title: falling is training
caption: Falling is part of riding, not a fail.
narration: Hey rider! Even great cyclists fall. Falling is part of learning, not a fail story.

title: helmet and check
caption: Helmet snug. Brakes bite. Tires happy.
narration: Helmet on every ride. Squeeze both brakes. Check tires, seat, and shoes that grip.

title: eyes and soft brakes
caption: Bike follows your eyes. Gentle brakes win.
narration: Look where you want to go. Soft hands. Squeeze both brakes gently, not one hard yank.

title: skip bad spots
caption: Driveways, doors, earbuds, bright colors.
narration: Stop at driveways. Watch car doors. No earbuds. Wear bright colors so you are seen.

title: tuck and roll
caption: Chin tucked. Arms soft. Roll, don't slap.
narration: Going over? Tuck your chin. No stiff arms. Bend and roll like a soft log.

title: protect your head
caption: Aim for soft ground. Keep the head safe.
narration: Aim for grass if you can. Land soft. Protect your head. Helmet stays on for a reason.

title: sit and breathe
caption: Dizzy, weird angle, lots of blood: get help.
narration: Sit. Breathe. Check body and bike. Dizzy, weird angle, lots of blood, or head feels wrong: get help.

title: brush off and ride
caption: Learn one thing. Ride again when ready.
narration: Brush off. Learn one thing. Check the bike. Ride again when ready, not as a dare.
